title: Razlo's Revelations

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: You're back. When I first met you, I didn't realize quite so much of my time would be spent with the new noodle stand owner, but here we are!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're back. When I first met you, I didn't realize quite so much of my time would be spent with the new noodle stand owner, but here we are!

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Who knows? You seem to be playing detective, trying to impress that malfunctioning bucket Dotson.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who knows? You seem to be playing detective, trying to impress that malfunctioning bucket Dotson.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Dammit. Maybe you DO have some idea of what's really happening.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Dammit. Maybe you DO have some idea of what's really happening.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I'm not so sure about that, but let's pretend that's true.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not so sure about that, but let's pretend that's true.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Some say he was a madman. Some say he was a hero. He was obsessed with finding a criminal mastermind called "Razlo."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some say he was a madman. Some say he was a hero. He was obsessed with finding a criminal mastermind called "Razlo."

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I wasn't, but I became him. When I read about The Phase Runner in the Feeds, I thought "Razlo" was a really great name.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wasn't, but I became him. When I read about The Phase Runner in the Feeds, I thought "Razlo" was a really great name.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Refreshingly honest. I respect people willing to admit they are out of their depth.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Refreshingly honest. I respect people willing to admit they are out of their depth.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Indeed he does. But... it's more complicated than you realize. He doesn't think I am the ORIGINAL Razlo. But he still thinks I am the REAL Razlo.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed he does. But... it's more complicated than you realize. He doesn't think I am the ORIGINAL Razlo. But he still thinks I am the REAL Razlo.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Then I killed him and had a MemTech upload his memories and experience into my neural augment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then I killed him and had a MemTech upload his memories and experience into my neural augment.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: If it were true, it would be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If it were true, it would be.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I'm literally telling you this insane story. Why would I share it, except to debunk it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm literally telling you this insane story. Why would I share it, except to debunk it?

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I am telling the truth.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am telling the truth.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: That's the part of the story you're stuck on?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's the part of the story you're stuck on?

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I don't expect anyone in this city to hold an intelligent thought in their head. You believe what you want to believe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't expect anyone in this city to hold an intelligent thought in their head. You believe what you want to believe.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Yes, well, common sense is a rare thing in Nivalis. But it is welcome.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, well, common sense is a rare thing in Nivalis. But it is welcome.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks Ava.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks Ava.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: That seems less likely than the obvious explanation: I am not a teenage criminal mastermind... and Dotson is insane.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That seems less likely than the obvious explanation: I am not a teenage criminal mastermind... and Dotson is insane.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I see. Well... you've made your decision. I suppose if I really am a criminal mastermind, you better watch your back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I see. Well... you've made your decision. I suppose if I really am a criminal mastermind, you better watch your back.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Now if you'll excuse me, I have to get back to reality. I have exams to study for and tuition to pay. Us law-abiders have to find part time jobs to make ends meet. Goodbye detective.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now if you'll excuse me, I have to get back to reality. I have exams to study for and tuition to pay. Us law-abiders have to find part time jobs to make ends meet. Goodbye detective.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But?

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: When he died of "natural causes", a note on his body was found that said, "If I die, Razlo got me."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When he died of "natural causes", a note on his body was found that said, "If I die, Razlo got me."

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: A good thing to sort of... roleplay. So I changed my name to Razlo, and I kinda... acted like I had a secret.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A good thing to sort of... roleplay. So I changed my name to Razlo, and I kinda... acted like I had a secret.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: What I think is mine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What I think is mine.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Dotson thinks I was born with my original name, "Albert Albumen", but I became so obsessed with the real Razlo that I tracked down the original.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Dotson thinks I was born with my original name, "Albert Albumen", but I became so obsessed with the real Razlo that I tracked down the original.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: "Albert Albumen"? Really?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Albert Albumen"? Really?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And then?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And then?

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Let's keep this whole conversation to ourselves now, shall we? We don't want people thinking you've lost your mind too. Goodbye.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's keep this whole conversation to ourselves now, shall we? We don't want people thinking you've lost your mind too. Goodbye.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: You better hope your friend Dotson comes back and you catch me before I arrange for you to have an accident.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You better hope your friend Dotson comes back and you catch me before I arrange for you to have an accident.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Gideon says there's more to you than I know. Is there?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gideon says there's more to you than I know. Is there?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Gideon says there's more to you than I know. Is there?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Gideon says there's more to you than I know. Is there?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...Who was "The Phaze Runner"?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...Who was "The Phaze Runner"?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, I am getting there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, I am getting there.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Honestly, still no real idea.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Honestly, still no real idea.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So who was The Phase Runner?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So who was The Phase Runner?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So who was The Phase Runner?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So who was The Phase Runner?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So YOU are that Razlo?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So YOU are that Razlo?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's really going on here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's really going on here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's horrific.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's horrific.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: "Albert Albumen?"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Albert Albumen?"

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you denying all this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you denying all this?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Because you're probably telling the truth.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because you're probably telling the truth.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Because you're probably telling the truth.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Because you're probably telling the truth.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But Dotson thinks you're the real Razlo.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But Dotson thinks you're the real Razlo.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But Dotson thinks you're the real Razlo.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But Dotson thinks you're the real Razlo.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: To evade my suspicions.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: To evade my suspicions.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Because Dotson will tell me all this eventually.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because Dotson will tell me all this eventually.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Because Dotson will tell me all this eventually.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Because Dotson will tell me all this eventually.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You expect me to believe you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You expect me to believe you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You expect me to believe you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You expect me to believe you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I believe you. I think Dotson is mistaken.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I believe you. I think Dotson is mistaken.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I believe you. I think Dotson is mistaken.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I believe you. I think Dotson is mistaken.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I'll watch your back. One day, I think we'll know for sure what the truth is about Razlo. Until then... let's be careful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll watch your back. One day, I think we'll know for sure what the truth is about Razlo. Until then... let's be careful.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I believe Dotson. I think you're a danger to everyone in this city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I believe Dotson. I think you're a danger to everyone in this city.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I believe Dotson. I think you're a danger to everyone in this city.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I believe Dotson. I think you're a danger to everyone in this city.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We'll stop you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We'll stop you.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I don't have enough information to make any accusations, but...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have enough information to make any accusations, but...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I don't know if Razlo really is a criminal, or if Dotson has indeed lost his mind...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know if Razlo really is a criminal, or if Dotson has indeed lost his mind...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I'm not sure that was the right choice... but time will tell.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure that was the right choice... but time will tell.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened to him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened to him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He was? So he is ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He was? So he is ...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You think I'm a complete idiot, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think I'm a complete idiot, right?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You think I'm a complete idiot, right?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You think I'm a complete idiot, right?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: But we may never get another chance to confront him like this. If you believe Razlo really is your enemy, now is the time to tell him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But we may never get another chance to confront him like this. If you believe Razlo really is your enemy, now is the time to tell him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do these threats ever work?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do these threats ever work?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tell me about "The Phaze Runner"!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell me about "The Phaze Runner"!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You seem to know a whole lot about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You seem to know a whole lot about it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You seem to know a whole lot about it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You seem to know a whole lot about it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure who is the insane one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure who is the insane one.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure who is the insane one.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure who is the insane one.
